name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 64 - Am 61
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 64a. Calls for the 2026 Budget to include the objective of allocating at least 0.7 % of the EU Member States’ Gross Domestic Product to official development assistance, as per the aim laid down in UN General Assembly Resolution 2625 (XXV) of 24 October 1970 and repeated in paragraph 43 of the document ‘Transforming our world: the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development’;
